releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.116 Release Gate Role Verification Fix
notes: Fixes the release-gate role preflight so authoritative /api/whoami 403 denials are accepted for normal owner, manager, and staff QA accounts.
Keeps System Administrator verification strict: the System Administrator QA account must still receive 200 verified platform authority.
Prevents correct non-platform denial responses from blocking Playwright before test execution.
Preserves the already deployed Firestore rules byte-for-byte.
